title: Find the Gnome 2
description:
Find the Gnome 2Hunt gnomes through hand-crafted 3D worlds — but watch out, they run! Spot a gnome hiding in a scene, and it'll try to dash for cover. Block its escape routes and chase it down with your drone before it disappears again.

Explore four colorful environments — forest, farm, village and city — each packed with interactive details, comic story cutscenes by renowned Dutch cartoonist Meinder, and a dynamic soundtrack by renowned indie composer Tobi Weiss.

 
Features:• Interactive levels, click and explore!

• Carefully handcrafted dioramas for each level.

• Multiple dynamic soundtracks by renowned indie composer Tobi Weiss.

• Enjoy cartoons that explain the story and background to the gnome world, and unlock cool concept art. All made by renowned Dutch cartoonist Meinder.

• There are 25+ achievements to get. 

• Full controller support and the ability to play with a keyboard and mouse combination. 

• Difficulty adjustments for if you want a more casual gameplay, or if you want to spice things up. Accessibel for all ages!
description_short: Spot the gnomes — before they spot you and run! Search colorful 3D worlds for hiding gnomes, then chase them down when they bolt. Cozy, charming, and surprisingly tricky. Based on Dutch gnome mythology.
